registered_rules.short_statement: Public I/O ports use independent positive namespaces and exact nominal TypeSchemaRef pins.
An effect selector requires a declared resource port, exact resource pin, full qualifier profile and closed operation support.
Recovery meter coverage is exhaustive and activation, attempt and usage bounds use checked arithmetic.
F/X relations match exact labels, taints, authority levels, flow kinds, sinks, regions and trust domains.
Proof context pins canonical relation content and changed snapshots invalidate prior proof results.
Scope retains complete compiler/context/resolver/root/assertion values and context-role partition.
Source, target, coordinate and declared occurrence origin must be complete and consistent.
Prerequisites retain original predicate/stage/subject/origin and all consumer edges.
References are complete typed evidence coordinates, not RuleIds or prose identities.
Derived complete reference sets use the typed minimum except six root boundary primaries None.
Only equal originating facts merge observations; distinct origins stay distinct.
Status, disposition, links, contradiction and observations remain required alongside identity.
The private successor constructor requires proof eligibility and successful complete bounded normalization.
Raw subjects preserve all thirteen parsed Raw fields, real declarative documents and physical byte associations without inventing historical input.
Raw analysis and canonical validation use the actual same nine-member context object and exact partition without a fabricated resolver.
Raw physical bytes, parsed declarations, diagnostic presentation, canonical validation and Checked states remain distinct; parser failure is not a port predicate.
The single positive_unique_io_ports case preserves the actual input-before-output stable numeric sort and reached positivity/uniqueness check before schema resolution.
Raw Source, exact schema constraint Target, original and sorted port Coordinate and both declarative paths identify the same real occurrence.
Zero and duplicate violations retain complete typed U32 occurrences and real predecessor evidence; positive facts have no contradiction and diagnostic strings cannot supply evidence.
Raw prerequisites and typed member references retain original stage and origin, all observations and consumers; one local positive port does not prove namespace coverage.
Future branch-created evidence is borrowed before diagnostic reduction; source, context and evidence lifetimes cannot produce a Checked token or trusted caller assertion.
